prompt: Reproduce the target cartoon face using a black fixed-width pen. Left and right refer to the viewer. Choose exactly one action per turn as JSON: {"op":"draw","points":[[x,y],...]}, {"op":"undo"}, or {"op":"stop"}. Coordinates are normalized to [0,1]. A draw is one connected path of 1 to 4 cubic Bezier segments: the initial point followed by three points per segment (4,7,10,13 points total). Every command, including an invalid action, consumes the 40-command budget. Stop when complete. Demonstrations, when present, show before canvas, action, and after canvas.
